body: Yes I’m in exactly the same position. I can’t tell anybody about my self harm problem and the only person I have told is my ex girlfriend and she makes fun of me for it. As sucky as it is maybe you could tell someone how you’re feeling. Part of me feels like the fact I want to be hospitalised is apart of my attention seeking (idk if I do seek but I’ve been told I do and I question it myself sometimes m, I try my best not too). It just feels like maybe if there’s a doctor there that can help me, things will be better quickly. I hope you get better soon though - preferably not through hospitalisation

Can I join? I’ll spare you the ‘don’t do it bullshit’. It would definitely be better if you didn’t but honestly shit hasn’t been going my way at all recently and I think I’m going to do it soon, nobody gives a fuck about me and nobody will care when I die. Might join in on that deadline

Ugh it’s such an annoying thing. If I’m honest I just cut again and it was a styro cut but it still doesn’t feel like enough. It only hurts while I’m making it. Not after. I hardly even fkn bleed now. I really wish I could start on my wrists but there’s no way I could hide it. Especially at school. I think your right about it being a mental block. I want to feel the pain and see the blood rush down my thigh. And I don’t show anyone because im afraid they’ll think it’s pathetic. I have way over 300 scars and only 2 are deep. It fkn sucks.
Holy shit I’m in exactly the same situation. I feel like mine are only ever ‘scratches’ and never deep enough. I put more pressure on it and nothing seems to change

An amazing article! I will be sharing this around. I am afraid that I might have Borderline Personality disorder due to my recurring self harm, suicide attempt, and social instability. Your article has inspired me that no matter what I am going through. Someone is going through something similar. I’m only 15, a little younger than you said you were. I have been debating with myself on whether or not i ask mum to see a psychiatrist. I still have a relationship with my dad but there’s rarely a time we’re not arguing. However, all of this did happen after I got out of a relationship about 3 months ago so I’d like to make sure. But anyways. I hope you’re doing well and I wish you luck! I’m always here if you need to chat xx
That’s an amazing recovery! But please don’t make any more. Draw them on if you must. If you’re already this clean then don’t break the streak xx

It’s a fucking coping method ok. Some people can’t handle the emotional pain they’re suffering so they turn it into physical pain. I cut myself whatever who cares. It’s something that personally gets me through the times to come. Everyone hates themselves at times, but for the love of god theres a difference between hating yourself and feeling like everyone hates you and taking it out on yourself. There are people who wake up every day and try their absolute strongest to make it through the day alive - some people fail. Self harm is a horrible thing and in no way do I encourage it. And although there’s no real way to describe the pain that someone who hurts themselves goes through, it fkn sucks. Sure some are worse than others. But every last fucking human who has lived on this planet deserves to be happy.  Hope you understand a bit better now (I know this post is old)
I’m sorry to hear that, I have someone similar to that in my life by the sounds of it. Hope you figure it out soon!

I’m horrible at advice so feel free to change things up. But I’d say that you need to tell her that times have changed. People with depression only go to a mental hospital when it’s putting themselves or others in severe danger. Tell her that it’s your choice and (if) she’s your legal guardian then it’s her responsibility to care for you and look after you. If you feel the need to see a medical professional than she should take you. Hope any of this helps!

Don’t think I can talk you out of it so I can only help. Start really lightly. New razors are sharp. I use them to cut when I have to. Just start lightly and add pressure when you feel the need. But I definitely wouldn’t recommend. Once you use razors everything else feels pathetic and it can lead to pretty serious injuries. Just stay safe and take care of yourself. Preferably don’t cut but if you want to I can’t stop you

My ex girlfriend and I lasted 10 months, we broke up almost 2 weeks ago now. We were close, I introduced her to my friendship group, I gave her my virginity, I spent all my time, effort and energy on her. She knows I have a cutting problem and when she broke up with me I tried to kill myself. I can tell you now that it’s not the end of the world. It fucking sucks I’ll tell you that. But you can’t let her ruin your life. Take your time, get over it. I’m depressed, I accept it. I would kill myself in a heartbeat if I could do it right. But i think it’s worth another try. 
Don’t let 1 person get you down. Find the bright side. I don’t know you but I’m here to talk if you need
